column1: Section 2, table 2a: Audience Motivations and Goals

What drives each audience to act, what they want right now, and what they want for their own life. Built from 412 caregiver posts and threads (303 Reddit, 109 forum). Rank 1 = most common within that audience and type. Motivation = What drives them to act? Situational goal = What do they want to happen right now in the caregiving? Life goal = What do they want for their own life?
